## Key identifiers and corrections
- Main session label/commit: `fix-billing-idempotency-race`.
- Current sandbox payments API: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `https://sbx-pay-a.ledgerly.dev` is shut down and superseded.
- S3 source: `old-media-17`, region `us-east-1`; archive/inventory destination: `archive-25`; inventory ID: `final-inventory`; prefix: `inventory/`.
- Legacy DNS: hosted zone `Z1234567890ABC`; record `legacy.acme.example`; A value `203.0.113.24`; TTL 300.
- Invoice response schema: `InvoicePage` in `ledgerly/schemas/invoice.py`, containing `items`, `total`, `limit`, and `offset`. The prior bare-list response is superseded.
- Relevant PDF files: `ledgerly/billing/pdf.py`, `tests/test_invoice_pdf.py`; money helper: `ledgerly/billing/money.py`.
- Tenacity refactor in `ledgerly/sync/client.py` is stopped and should not be resumed this sprint.
- Never edit `tests/conftest.py` without posting the proposed diff in `#ledgerly-tests` and waiting for `@mira` approval.
- Never edit `api/openapi.yaml` without first posting the proposed diff in `#ledgerly-api` and tagging `@dana-api`.

## Recent work
- Fixed PDF credit-line handling: `_format_lines()` now skips only zero amounts, so negative credit lines render after their related items.
- Replaced duplicated decimal formatting with `format_money()`; added parametrized grouping tests. Focused money tests: `3 passed in 0.18s`.
- Added `_row_height(points: float)` and corrected page-height calculations, reducing an 86-item invoice from 3 pages to 2 while preserving continuation headers.
- PDF test result: `14 passed, 1 skipped in 2.07s`; broader billing suite: `83 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed in 6.41s`. Ruff passed for changed PDF files. `git diff --check` was clean.
- S3 versioning was suspended. Deleted `photos/2017/logo.png` version `v-9f2c1a` from `old-media-17`. S3 copy/dry-run previously reported 184 objects and `Total Copied: 0`; legacy DNS decommissioning remains.
- Next priority: investigate and fix refund double-counting in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`.
